notes.title: Coming soon: CG 5 and CG: Girls 2
notes.content:

There are two weeks left (November 7, 2024) until the fifth installment of the free-to-play offshoot of the Coloring Game franchise is released to Early Access.

Ability to upload custom pictures for free (limitation on image size, maximum 125x125 px.);
3D mode;
The game is based on the Coloring Game: Studio core (improved performance relative to previous games in the series).

notes.title: Update 2.4.5
notes.content:
The game now features the lazy coloring mode that doesn’t involve the left mouse button. On activating this mode, the program automatically blocks the previously colored pixels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940807/efd4ba72aaf34741e6fd4150c8449fa96a7f6cc4.png

notes.title: Update 2.4.3
Season Pass Update
notes.content:
The majority of players have supported us by purchasing the Season Pass right at the start of its sales (70% of the total sales of DLCs for CG3). As a compliment from the developer, we have decided to adjust the initial plan by releasing final images from the upcoming DLC (Art Museum) right now. 


 This DLC contains 6 images with the total volume being 528,200 px (out of 1,515,700 px).
 Another 400,000 px image is going to be added between August 14 and August 21. UPD: Added.
 The last three images are going to be added on August 26 (587,500 px).
 The Art Museum DLC will be available for purchase on August 28.


Please note that the Art Museum is not going to feature animation for completed images. The majority of images represent highly dynamic scenes, while the animation of eyes and other small parts of the images has failed to produce positive results. That is why we have decided to make an exception and not to add animation to this DLC. I hope for the players’ understanding on this matter.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1362600/Coloring_Game_3__Season_Pass/

notes.title: Add New DLCs to Your Wishlist
notes.content:
Following numerous requests, I’ve decided to create DLCs for the Coloring Game 3.

Coloring Game 3 - Video Game No.1
Release: July 31
Theme: inspired by NES, SNES, Game Boy, and other games.
Size: 45 images / 350,000px
Duration: 8 hours (Pen Mode) / 4 hours (Fill Mode)
Base price: $1.99.

The first DLC to the Coloring Game 3. Many small-sized images. Ideal for playing in the Fill Mode. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1362601/Coloring_Game_3__Video_Game_No_1/

Art Museum
Release: August 28
Theme:  artworks
Size: 10 images / 1,500,000px
Duration: 40 hours
Base price: $7.99.

The second DLC to the Coloring Game 3. Contains large highly-detailed images.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1354790/Coloring_Game_3__Art_Museum/

Video Game No.2
Release: November 13
Theme: inspired by NES, SNES, Game Boy, and other games.
Size: 15 images / 900,000px
Duration: 20 hours (Pen Mode) / 9 hours (Fill Mode)
Base price: $4.99.

The third DLC to the Coloring Game 3. Middle-sized images. Ideal for playing in the Fill Mode.  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1362602/Coloring_Game_3__Video_Game_No_2/

Season Pass
Release: July 29
Base price: $11.99.

The Season Pass will enable you to get all the commercial content for the CG3 with a 20% discount. 
Besides, Season Pass owners are going to get access to the content of the DLCs two days ahead of the official release.
